"Reindex now" from the Chat RAG panel. Deletes and recreates the chunks of the three honest scopes (RN-219) from the CURRENT state — there is no automatic watcher on push/session close (decision recorded in ADR 0079/0080). Can take a while on projects with many sessions: it runs one indexing pass per session, each possibly calling the embedding provider in batch.
